title: fix(components): page:tabs probes related counts from the named record, not the loaded row (objectui#13010 part 1)
body:
Part of #13010
Clause-②: no

Part 1 of the card, Wanted items 1–2, under the seat rulings in comment 6258704497. Item 3 is dropped because its premise was disproved. Items 4 and 5 stay on the card.

## What changed

- **Item 2 (landed).** `page:tabs` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`) now keys its related-count badge probes on `ctx.recordId`, the record the context names (the route's id on a record page). It used to key them on `ctx.data.id`, the id inside the loaded row, so every probe waited for the record read and went out a wave behind it. `recordId` is a required member of `RecordContextValue` and every provider fills it, so this is a single read, not a fallback. A list whose visibility the record decides keeps that wait: one behind a node-level `visibleWhen`, or in a tab whose item-level `visibleWhen` decides it, is probed once the row has landed, as before.
- **Item 1 (not landed; fallback B, as the ruling allows).** Rule A was to share the rail's in-flight read with the tab badge through `RelatedCountStore.fetch`. It cannot register first without a timing hack. After item 2, the tab strip's probe effect runs in the first commit and reaches `RelatedCountStore.fetch` after a single microtask hop (its `getObjectSchema` await). The rail's read is gated by its `IntersectionObserver` visibility latch, which flips after a frame, and only then does it start its own schema await. So the probe is always on the wire first; the after-table below shows the `top=1` probes issued ahead of the `top=3` reads. Making the rail win would mean dropping its visibility gate (which keeps a `hidden xl:flex` rail from querying at all) and relying on effect order plus microtask order. Each badge probe now shares wave 1 with its card's read, so the extra wave is gone; the three count requests remain.
- **Item 3 (dropped).** The two `security/explain` POSTs on a record open have different bodies, `operation: update` and `operation: delete`, from `plugin-detail`'s `useRecordEditable`. objectui#11699's in-flight sharing is in the card's pin. The harness pins the two bodies.

## Wave table: the rendered harness, before and after

`RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` mounts the real `RecordDetailView` over the real `ObjectStackAdapter` under StrictMode, on a HotCRM-shaped authored page: a tab strip whose Related tab holds 3 related lists, the third with a declared status filter, plus a reference rail aside with 3 entries at limit 3. A held transport answers one wave at a time.

| | Wave 1 | Wave 2 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before (`d0934b919d`) | approvals; explain update; explain delete; record; sys_user top=50; sys_comment; sys_activity top=200; quote/line/task top=3 | quote/line/task top=1 | 13 requests, 2 waves |
| After (`355c0146f3`) | all of the above, the three top=1 probes included (issued before the three top=3 reads) | — | 13 requests, 1 wave |

In the card's in-app measurement the probes were wave 3 (at 1858 ms, after the record landed at 1.81 s). That wave is the one this removes.

## Pins

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-probe-route-id-13010.test.tsx`:
  - an ungated list probes before the row lands, scoped to `recordId`;
  - a list behind a node-level `visibleWhen` waits for the row;
  - a tab whose item-level `visibleWhen` reads true while the row is absent waits for it;
  - CONTROL: with no record named, nothing is probed.
- The harness:
  - every read is in wave 1;
  - CONTROL: the task badge, whose declared filter differs from its rail card's, still probes with its own filter (`not_equals`), and the card's read carries none;
  - the two explain bodies are update and delete.
- Pin (a) from the ruling (no `top=1` probe where the card's read answered) is NOT here; see item 1 above.

## Ablations

Each was run once through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks the anchor counts. Each restore was proven by blob hash: `09c621807d6a` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- Re-keying `parentId` on `ctx?.data?.id`: 3 tests red (the harness's wave-1 pin, and the ungated-list and node-gate pins).
- Deleting the node-gate filter line: 1 red (the node-level `visibleWhen` pin).
- Deleting the item-gate return: 1 red (the item-level `visibleWhen` pin). On its first run this ablation stayed green, because that pin's predicate (`record.plan == 'pro'`) already reads false while the row is absent, so the line was untested. I rewrote the pin's predicate to `record.plan != 'free'`, which reads true while the row is absent, and on the rerun it went red.

## Verification (head `355c0146f3`)

- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock: 32 files, 252 tests passed. The run covers the `page-tabs-*` family (the objectui#12987 `visibleWhen` count pins and the objectui#12992 scope builder included), `related-count-store*`, `record-reference-rail*`, the `RecordDetailView.related*` pins (objectui#8882, objectui#4664, objectui#5795, objectui#11733), `childWriteRefreshesParent-12244`, `recordOpenRequests-*`, `accessibleNames-12625`, `authoredActivityThreading-12249`, `PagePreview`, `SchemaRenderer.visibleWhenRecordBinding`, and the two new files.
- Closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: exit 0. `@object-ui/components` type-check (src and tests): exit 0, re-run after the final edit. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check: exit 0.
- eslint on the 3 changed source and test files: 0 errors. `containers.tsx` has 94 warnings, the same as on base.
- Pre-tsc battery:
  - exit 0: phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, test-path-roots, new-line-citations, vi-mock-specifiers, vi-mock-inherit, and check-hand-rolled-comment-mask;
  - `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with no-artifact (it needs a whole-workspace build), so it is NOT MEASURED; the order notes it may exit 1 on main.
- Changeset checks: changeset-fixed, changeset-presence and changeset-no-major all exit 0.
- Declared to CI: the full package directories of `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, and repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- The probes no longer wait for the record body. On a record that turns out to be missing or refused, the ungated badge probes still go out once, beside the record read, before the page swaps to its not-found or denied state. Each costs one count request and draws nothing.
- Not an objectui#13010 item: a page that renders the rail and the tab badge for the same unfiltered relation still pays two reads per relation in one wave. Removing that needs the rail's read to register before the probe. A deterministic way to do that would be a store-level change or a rework of the rail's visibility gate; that is the seat's call.
